item.title: Northeast Ohio blood donors needed following widespread winter storms
item.description: Nonprofit Vitalant is urging eligible donors to start February with a lifesaving donation, according to a news release. January winter storms caused over 1,300 uncollected donations due to blood drive cancellations nationwide, including 300 in Northeast Ohio, the release said. Making an appointment now is vital to keep local and national blood supplies stable for […]

item.title: Bruce Thornton’s 21 points lead Ohio State over USC, 89-82
item.description: COLUMBUS — Bruce Thornton scored 21 points and hit two late throws to help Ohio State secure an 89-82 win over USC on Feb. 11. Ohio State (16-6, 8-6 Big Ten) trailed 43-40 at halftime after opening 2 of 13 at the free-throw line, but Thornton steadied the Buckeyes in the second half. He became the fifth player in program history to reach 1,935 career points and moved into fifth all-time in Ohio State scoring. item.title: Sam Merrill scores 32 as Cavaliers beat Wizards 138-113 in James Harden’s home debut
item.description: Sam Merrill scored a career-high 32, Donovan Mitchell added 30, and the Cleveland Cavaliers rolled to a 138-113 victory over the Washington Wizards in James Harden’s first home game wearing wine and gold. item.title: James Harden ‘drove Cavs fans nuts,’ now they love him | Jeff Schudel
item.description: The Cavaliers are 3-0 since trading Darius Garland to the Los Angeles Clippers last week to acquire James Harden. The Cavs have won five straight and 10 of their last 11 games. As good as that looks as the Cavs continue their climb in the Eastern Conference standings (34-21, fourth place), the best is yet to come, according to Coach Kenny Atkinson. Harden had eight assists in the first half Feb. 11 at Rocket Arena as the Cavs built a 76-61 lead over the lowly Washington Wizards at intermission.
